rules.text: Never create new .md files. Rules live only in .claude/rulebooky/rules.json.
Never run git push --force or reset --hard without asking.
Before any non-trivial work: run `task set` (goal, method, forbid) and `task add-req` for each requirement in any document the user told you to follow.
Mark a requirement done only with evidence: `task done N --evidence ...`.
Answer in short point-form unless asked otherwise.
